import hashlib
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

EXPECTED_SHA = "ac29a73e688da39485f7a5a4ab707944e18542c9"
EXPECTED_BOOT_ID = "9f707aa9-7d70-4bb6-b9f5-44dd7fdd3897"
EXPECTED_RELEASE = "release-colab-external-images_20261001-060042_RC00"
ROOT = pathlib.Path("/content/MESC-retry2")
CUSTODY = pathlib.Path("/content/mrl0809-v2-retry2-custody")
LOG = pathlib.Path("/content/mrl0809-v2-retry2-launch.log")
PY = ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"
DRIVER = ROOT / "scripts/mesc_mrl_0809_stage4_v2_retry_2_driver.py"


def check_output(cmd, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(cmd, cwd=cwd, text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()

boot_id = pathlib.Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
release = os.environ.get("COLAB_RELEASE_TAG", "").strip()
gpu = check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name,memory.total", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"])
head = check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], ROOT)
live = check_output(["git", "ls-remote", "--exit-code", "origin", "refs/heads/main"], ROOT).split()[0]
status = check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"], ROOT)
free_bytes = shutil.disk_usage("/content").free

print(f"FINAL_BOOT_ID={boot_id}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_RELEASE={release}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_GPU={gpu}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_HEAD={head}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_LIVE_MAIN={live}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_TRACKED_CLEAN={status == ''}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_FREE_BYTES={free_bytes}", flush=True)
print(f"FINAL_CUSTODY_EXISTS={CUSTODY.exists()}", flush=True)

if boot_id != EXPECTED_BOOT_ID:
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: Colab runtime boot identity changed")
if release != EXPECTED_RELEASE:
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: Colab release identity changed")
if gpu != "Tesla T4, 15360":
    raise SystemExit(f"REFUSE: GPU drift: {gpu!r}")
if head != EXPECTED_SHA or live != EXPECTED_SHA or status:
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: canonical/live/clean invariant failed")
if CUSTODY.exists():
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: custody already exists")
if free_bytes < 25025488695:
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: free-space preflight failed")
if os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN"):
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: Hugging Face credential present")
for rel in (
    "specs/mesc-experiment-0/mrl-0809-successor-v2-stage4-retry-2-failure-record.json",
    "specs/mesc-experiment-0/mrl-0809-successor-v2-stage4-retry-2-result.json",
):
    if (ROOT / rel).is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSE: consumed record exists: {rel}")

if LOG.exists():
    raise SystemExit("REFUSE: launch log already exists")

env = os.environ.copy()
env["MESC_MRL0809_ZERO_COST_ATTESTATION"] = "1"
env["MESC_COLAB_RUNTIME_ID"] = boot_id
env.pop("HF_TOKEN", None)
env.pop("HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN", None)

cmd = [
    str(PY),
    str(DRIVER),
    "--repository-root", str(ROOT),
    "--custody", str(CUSTODY),
    "--python-executable", str(PY),
    "--expected-canonical-revision", EXPECTED_SHA,
]
print("DRIVER_INVOCATION_BEGIN", flush=True)
print("COMMAND=" + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
with LOG.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as log:
    completed = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, check=False)
print(f"DRIVER_RC={completed.returncode}", flush=True)
print(f"LAUNCH_LOG={LOG}", flush=True)
if CUSTODY.exists():
    for path in sorted(p for p in CUSTODY.rglob("*") if p.is_file()):
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        print(f"EVIDENCE {path.relative_to(CUSTODY)} bytes={len(raw)} sha256={hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}", flush=True)
print("DRIVER_INVOCATION_END", flush=True)
sys.exit(completed.returncode)
